description: Search the DartzDabz directory of AI agent tools (MCP servers, x402 pay-per-call APIs and agent platforms) by keyword, with optional type and category filters. Returns name, type, category, the latest automated 0-100 trust score (null when not scored) and the DartzDabz page URL. Official vendor MCP servers rank first on ties.

category.description: Optional category id: payments, search, dev, data, productivity, ai, commerce, security, other (see get_directory_counts).

query.description: Keywords, e.g. "github", "web search", "weather". Empty lists top tools.

type.description: Optional: limit to MCP servers, x402 APIs or agent platforms (app).

name: search_tools
title: Search the DartzDabz AI agent tool directory
